capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database nominal 79 kWh for the Premium RWD (Tesla 4680, 2026, European listing); US Premium RWD assumed the same. Unproven: this is a European listing ("available since April 2026"); no US page shows the US Premium RWD pack, and InsideEVs says 4680 chemistry is undisclosed (NMC is EV Database's label). Notebookcheck says the RWD has the same battery size as its AWD sibling (82/79 in the existing AWD records), so sources conflict.
